versions.changelog:
Initial release: Skill for Stove Protocol Maker API management.

- Supports managing institutional Maker user orders, positions, and real-time order status via the official API.
- Implements JWT authentication and environment switching (test/prod) with flexible base URL configuration.
- Provides a ready-to-use Python script (maker_api.py) that wraps common API operations (query, create, cancel orders; check positions and nonce; estimate fees).
- Offers WebSocket guidance for subscribing to order status changes.
- Ensures secure handling of JWT tokens and parameter validation according to API documentation constraints.
